protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: First-party GHSA-f9f8-rm49-7jv2 (withdrawn_at=null) and CVE.org CVE-2026-45793 (cveMetadata.state=PUBLISHED) describe a real CWE-200 leak: github-oauth tokens that fail character validation are interpolated into UnexpectedValueException and printed by Symfony Console to stderr/CI logs. On tag 2.9.7, Factory.php:357 calls $io->loadConfiguration($config); BaseIO.php:142-143 uses Preg::isMatch('{^[.A-Za-z0-9_]+$}', $token) then throw new UnexpectedValueException('... invalid characters: "'.$token.'"'). Composer\Console\Application extends Symfony\Component\Console\Application, so the uncaught exception reaches the default error renderer. Hyphen-bearing ghs_<id>_<base64url-JWT> GitHub Actions tokens fail that allowlist and become the trigger; the disclosure primitive is the token interpolation.
